notes.title: Good news!
notes.content:
Good news!

The next update of the game has been released.

We have added two new girls.
A player level system has been introduced, which will be developed in the future.
Fixed Japanese language.
The connection of progress to the Steam account has been completed, as well as the implementation of some functions has been prepared.
Minor bugs fixed.

A lot of technical work has been done to work with dialogues.
Prepared for a major update.

Our team is doing everything possible to improve and deepen the game.

Thanks to everyone who supported us and our game!

notes.title: Good news!
notes.content:
Now the game has 3D jigsaw puzzle as one of the gameplay elements.
A new girl has also been added.
Fixed bug with text in settings.
And also made a lot of minor fixes.

Our team is doing its best to improve and deepen the game. We have many more updates and content in the future.

Thanks to everyone who supported us and our game!
